native_rule.creator: yugandhar.mocherla@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.description: This query detects enumeration and discovery of credentials within the Registry, including Putty sessions.
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Possible Registry Credential Enumeration
native_rule.s1ql: (tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase "query HKLM /f password /t REG_SZ /s" OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase "query HKCU /f password /t REG_SZ /s" OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase "query HKCU\Software\SimonTatham\PuTTY\Sessions /t REG_SZ /s") dataSource.category = 'security' dataSource.name in ('SentinelOne', 'Windows Event Logs')
